map.天然气 2.8 元/m³、热值 9.6 kWh/m³、锅炉效率 90%：有效热成: Natural gas 2.8 CNY/m³, calorific value 9.6 kWh/m³, boiler efficiency 90%: effective heat cost ≈2.8/(9.6×0.9)=0.324 CNY/kWh heat. At the same heat, electric heating is 0.58 CNY/kWh, so gas is cheaper. Tip: when the electricity price is low or a heat pump has COP>1.8, electric heating may overtake.

map.热泵和燃气怎么选？: How to choose between a heat pump and gas?
map.热泵 COP>燃气效率/气价·电价 时更省；低温区热泵退化需实测对比。: A heat pump is cheaper when COP > gas efficiency / gas price · electricity price; in low-temperature zones heat pump performance degrades, so field comparison is needed.
map.燃料费用（本页代码口径）：燃料费=用量×单价（元）；联动量：单位里程费用=燃料费: Fuel cost (as implemented on this page): fuel cost = amount × unit price (CNY); related values: cost per kilometer = fuel cost ÷ mileage (CNY/km), fuel consumption per 100 km = amount ÷ mileage × 100 (L/100km), mileage per liter = mileage ÷ amount (km/L). Validation: all three fields are required by the input guard and must be valid numbers; amount and mileage must be >0 and the unit price must not be negative, otherwise prompt and stop. Criteria: no fixed grading; fuel consumption per 100 km and mileage per liter are reciprocals after unit conversion.
